title: Host architecture step 1: the first extraction — command completion → execution record → credited check, through the EngramHost facade
outcome: Step 1 of docs/features/host-architecture.md section 10, as section 9 specifies it (brief on master since fab2623). The recorder reports each provider event as a typed observation. A command event is recorded first as an admission on the host event log, under the state lock, then handed to a separate execution owner that records the transition once and returns an immutable receipt. The facade's typed operation replaces the five direct check-machinery functions at their seven call sites in recorders.rs. The host-write, turn-start, watcher and test-run-tick calls become distinct facade operations with unchanged bodies. The execution records and observations are provisional mirrors: nothing that decides credit reads them in this step, and the checks, captures, carried fence and checkpoint run exactly as before. Owned state uses option 1 of section 3.1 (real Rust modules with private fields). Moves and behaviour changes are separate commits (rule 9), each with its own gate and review pair. The landed per-session scoping of unplaced commands (204b95b) and every other correctness fix on master are part of the base and are preserved (section 9.5).
acceptance: After the step no file outside the component names a function of the check machinery.

Each commit of the step passes the full five-stage gate on its exact reviewed tree and has a review pair with no outstanding finding of Medium or higher; run directories and diff hashes are cited in notes.

The five new proofs of section 9.5 exist and pass: the end-to-end fixture equal byte for byte (observations, evidence, idempotency key) to one captured at the extraction's exact base; the ingress seal on the projection deciding nothing yet; a stuck consumer delaying no recording, checkpoint or cleanup; one terminal transition per execution; and the boundary shown by the build.

The tests section 9.4 names (src/tests/engram_turn_checks.rs, engram_one_call_checks.rs, engram_lost_shell_overlap.rs, engram_carried_checks.rs, engram_carried_gate_live.rs, engram_turn_observations.rs, engram_host_adapter.rs) pass with their assertions unchanged; only direct calls of the five replaced functions change, to the facade operation.
